reviews.text:
My cat Xena spent a few days with Cristina and it was wonderful! It was the first time she'd been left without us, and although she was a little shy at first, she gradually gained confidence and absolutely loved playing with us!
We're so grateful for their help. Thank you so much! 🤩👏 …

Cristina is the best cat sitter we've ever had. She's incredibly sweet and kind to our cat, Ollie. You can tell she truly cares for him and loves him like he's her own. She's very creative with games, treats, affection, and stimulation, and Ollie is always happy and calm when we get home.

Cristina is also extremely responsible and communicative—everything we could ask for in a cat sitter and more. We trust her completely and are so grateful to have found someone who always goes the extra mile. We wholeheartedly recommend her!

Thank you, Cristina, for taking care of Jumpy and Bebé as if they were your own, for doing your job with the cats like a true mother to them. I would entrust them to you for a thousand more years and would always be sure that you would give 100%.

Cristina has been my cat's cat sitter since he was a kitten. We've been using her for six months now, but we've booked many cat sittings, and every single one has been a fantastic experience. My cat plays with her like no one else and has a blast (I can see this because Cristina sends videos and photos during the sittings). She's also very reliable, always follows instructions, and tailors the sittings to each cat's needs (age, activity level, etc.). You can tell she adores cats and is dedicated to doing her job well. Thank you so much, Cristina :)

If you want peace of mind when you go away knowing your cats will be in good hands, contact Cristina. She understands cats perfectly and dedicates time to caring for and playing with them. She connected with mine from the very first moment.

Cristina is truly the best. I can't thank her enough for everything she's done for me and my two precious babies. She takes her time and always makes sure they're happy and well cared for. I highly recommend her services. You'll have peace of mind while you're away, knowing Cristina will take care of your kittens and give them so much love.

I hired the aromatic garden service for my cats and I'm very satisfied. The service was excellent from the very beginning, with very professional follow-up. Cristina is very knowledgeable and sensitive, and my cats have responded very well to the experience. I definitely recommend it!

Colin has shared several play sessions with Cris that I highly recommend. In the following days, Colin is more active and affectionate, and he asks us to play the same way Cris plays with him, encouraging him to experiment much more… Thank you, Cris!! We hope to play with you again soon ❤️

Cristy cared for our Luli for two weeks, and my kitten was absolutely thrilled to play with her every day. By the second day, Luli was already completely smitten with Cristy and was incredibly active in all the videos she sent us. Cristy is a true cat lover; it's evident from her very first visit. You can see the love and dedication she puts into every visit. Cristy's commitment to making you feel like you're not far from your kitten is amazing. Every day I wasn't with Luli, I received tons of videos and photos showing my kitten having so much fun jumping around and discovering new games with Cristy. We are absolutely delighted with the service Cristy provides. If you want to go on vacation and don't want to feel stressed about leaving your kitten, Cristy is the perfect choice!

Cristina treated my 6-month-old cat, Moka, for predatory play. I consulted with her about appropriate play methods, and she prescribed a scented garden. Now Moka is 15 months old and no longer exhibits predatory play, and we continue using the scented garden to enrich her environment and senses. I highly recommend her for her empathy, care, and professionalism. We are very happy, and my cat is even happier; she is a happy, balanced, calm, and affectionate cat.

Cris looked after our cat over the long weekend, and I couldn't be more grateful! She understands cats, prepares games and challenges for them, and makes every moment with them a joy. She kept us updated with photos and videos of how our cat was doing and truly exudes passion for her work. We trust her completely!

My cats are very well looked after by her whenever we go away; they play with her more in the summer than with us the rest of the year. She also takes care of our fish and plants. She's completely trustworthy, and we know we can leave a professional in charge.

Cris has been taking care of our three cats for several years, and we always know they'll have a great time playing and being very well looked after during her visits. She keeps us informed about everything and is very patient when one of them is shy, giving them their space and encouraging them to come out little by little.
Highly recommended!

Cris has been taking care of my cats for the past five years during my many absences, and they are always happy with her. 100% recommended, 100% responsible, 100% professional. I wholeheartedly recommend her services.

I couldn't have found better hands to leave my Coco in while I was on vacation. You can see Cris's passion for our feline companions and how well she understands them. It's not just about feeding them; it's the variety of games, the affection, and the companionship. I've learned so much from her videos and advice. I'm absolutely certain that if I go on vacation again, I'll ask Cris to look after my cat while I'm away (she's earned her complete affection and trust). I left very worried, and the peace of mind that comes from knowing you've chosen the right professional is priceless.

We always have a great experience with Cristina. When we need her to look after our cats, we feel completely at ease knowing they are perfectly cared for.

Cris is the best thing that's happened to me in the last few months. For a while, I couldn't really leave the house because I didn't know any cat sitters I trusted enough to leave my furry friends with. Until she came along, and I feel …

I met Cris in 2020. I loved her project, CuidoTuJungla: catsitting, playtime, and support (Bach flower remedies, aromatherapy, zoopharmacognosy, etc.). She's a fantastic catsitter and also a gardening expert.
100% recommended!
My partner and I are very happy with the care Cris gives our cat, Bruna. We've been trusting her for almost two years and recommend her to anyone who needs her services. …
